auctions.title: Artwork auctions

bidding.tooLow: Your bid is below the current minimum. Enter at least {minimum}.
bidding.invalidAmount: Enter a positive rupee amount with at most two decimal places.
bidding.minor: You must be at least 18 years old to bid.
bidding.declarationRequired: Confirm that you are an adult and accept the binding bid statement.

bidding.notOpen: Bidding has not opened for this lot.
bidding.unavailable: That lot is no longer available for bidding.
bidding.limit: The highest accepted bid has reached the amount limit.

admin.lead: Reserve verified original artwork with current auction consent, then schedule its public listing.
admin.noArtwork: No eligible artwork is currently available.
admin.storyHint: Describe the work and its inspiration. Do not include a child’s full name, school, location or other identifying details.
admin.opens: Opening date and time in IST (required)
admin.closes: Closing date and time in IST (required)
admin.reserveNote: The reserve price is not disclosed to visitors.
admin.noCredit: Auction consent is no longer current.
admin.error: The lot could not be updated. Check eligibility, current consent, dates and price.
